tasks.label: N64: Build ROM
tasks.command: flatpak-spawn --host distrobox enter n64-dev -T -- bash -c 'cd "/home/deck/n64_test_project" && make'

tasks.label: N64: Compile & Flash to X7
tasks.command: flatpak-spawn --host distrobox enter n64-dev -T -- bash -c 'cd "/home/deck/n64_test_project" && make && TERM=xterm UNFLoader -l -d -r n64-demo.z64'

tasks.label: N64: Clean Build
tasks.command: flatpak-spawn --host distrobox enter n64-dev -T -- bash -c 'cd "/home/deck/n64_test_project" && make clean'

tasks.label: N64: Run in ares Emulator
args: flatpak-spawn --host setsid flatpak run --share=network dev.ares.ares --gdb-server=2159 /home/deck/n64_test_project/n64-demo.z64 & sleep 10 && tail -f /dev/null
